title: Basic life support steps

source.name: ANZCOR Guideline 8, Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (approved April 2021), section 3.0, and the ANZCOR Basic Life Support flowchart (reviewed August 2023)

status: Reviewed by our clinical lead, 15 Nov 2026

continueUntil.say: Keep CPR going until the person responds or breathes normally.
continueUntil.source: ANZCOR Basic Life Support flowchart (reviewed August 2023), bottom panel

steps.name: Danger
steps.say: Check the area is safe for you, others and the person.
steps.detail: Deal with any risk before you go closer.

question.ask: Is it safe for you to go closer?

lines.text: Cabin pressure or air alarm: put on your suit or mask first.
Toxic leak alarm: put on your mask, and move the person to clean air if you can.
Fire or smoke: follow the fire procedure first.
Power or equipment hazard: switch it off before you touch the person.
Person outside in a suit: get them into the airlock and pressurised before you start.
At 0 g: secure yourself, and stop loose objects or floating liquid, before you move in.
Moon or Mars dust brought inside: keep it away from the person's eyes, nose and mouth.
Vehicles or machinery: stop them, or move away from them, first.
Fallen power lines: stay well back. Do not touch the person until the power is off.
Snake nearby: keep clear, and keep the person still.
Heat or a dust storm: get the person into shade or shelter if you can do it safely.
If you cannot make it safe, call for help and wait.

steps.name: Response
steps.say: Check whether the person responds to you.
steps.detail: If they do not respond, go on to the next step.

question.ask: Does the person respond to you?

priority.say: Send for help: priority call to Earth
priority.earth: Send for help: priority call to the RFDS base
priority.note: Urgent, not yet life-threatening: like a Pan-Pan call in aviation.
priority.sent: Priority call sent. SYNTHETIC: no real call is made in this demo.

steps.name: Send for help
steps.detail: If someone else is there, one calls while another fetches the defibrillator.

steps.name: Airway
steps.detail: How to open it: placeholder, awaiting clinician review.

steps.name: Breathing
steps.say: Check whether the person is breathing normally.
steps.detail: Not breathing, or only an odd gasp: go on and start CPR.

steps.name: CPR

gravity.zero: Strap the person down before you start CPR.

steps.detail: Push at about 100 to 120 a minute. Keep pauses short.

ratio.source: ANZCOR Guideline 8, section 3.0 step 6 and section 2.0; Basic Life Support flowchart, box C

pace.source: ANZCOR Guideline 8, section 3.1 and Recommendation 5: about 100 to 120 a minute. The marker beats at 110, the middle of that range (the app's choice).

steps.name: Defibrillation
steps.say: Attach the defibrillator as soon as it arrives.
steps.detail: Then do what its prompts tell you.
